ja.title: 摂動の当てものを一つの識別力で結ぶ：top-10・倍率・識別スコアの換算とExPert公開値への当てはめ
ja.summary: 摂動の retrieval 指標を、等分散ガウスの M 択強制選択モデルの一つの識別力 d′ で換算できるかを、ExPert の公開された recall@k に当てはめて探索的に調べた。問い合わせごとの違い、候補数、倍率の定義、棄権が読み方に与える影響を示す。
ja.seo_description: top-k recall・MRR・識別スコア・倍率を d′ と候補数で換算し、ExPert の公開値へ当てはめた探索的な解析。
ja.seo_title: 摂動 retrieval 指標を一つの識別力で結ぶ

en.title: Putting perturbation-retrieval metrics on one discriminability scale: top-k, fold over chance and discrimination scores applied to ExPert's released values
en.summary: An exploratory check of whether perturbation-retrieval metrics convert through one discriminability d′ in an equal-variance Gaussian M-alternative forced-choice model, fitted to ExPert's released recall@k. It shows how query heterogeneity, candidate count, fold definitions and abstention change how reported numbers read.
en.seo_description: Converting top-k recall, MRR, discrimination scores and fold over chance through d′ and candidate count, applied to ExPert's released values.
en.seo_title: Perturbation retrieval metrics on one scale
